title: Woman Faces 14 Years in Jail for Keeping KSh 33,000 Sent to Wrong M-Pesa Number
description: Mary Nanjala and Roselyne Nyongesa face up to 14 years imprisonment or KSh 5 million fine after allegedly refusing to return KSh 33,000 mistakenly sent via M-Pesa.

title: 1,327 Cannabis Plants Uprooted in Wakigunyi Village, Vihiga County
description: Police and local administration uprooted 1,327 cannabis plants concealed in a maize plantation in Wakigunyi Village, Vihiga County. The plantation owner escaped arrest and remains at large as investigations continue at Mbale Police Station.
imageAlt: 1,327 Cannabis Plants Uprooted in Wakigunyi Village, Vihiga County

title: JKUAT Student and TikToker Derrick Omollo Dies After Falling Into Quarry While Fleeing Attackers in Juja
description: Derrick Omollo, a 21-year-old JKUAT student and TikTok content creator with over 106,000 followers, died after falling into a 40-metre deep quarry while fleeing from four knife-wielding men who attacked him and colleagues during a content-shooting picnic in Juja, Kiambu County on Tuesday.
imageAlt: JKUAT Student and TikToker Derrick Omollo Dies After Falling Into Quarry While Fleeing Attackers in Juja

description: A 60-year-old man from Munzatsi village in Gisambai Location, Vihiga County, has been arrested at Gambogi Police Station after allegedly setting fire to his own house in a domestic dispute with his first wife.
